why: internal/herd/config validates it at author time, so a repository learns its
policy is wrong from `tk` rather than from a morning that quietly swept
nothing. cloud/factory/src/sweeps.ts is the one that ACTS on it: a cron
trigger wakes the Worker, and this declaration decides what runs unattended
Two readers of one format is the shape of the bug this repository has already
paid for once — a fix landed in TypeScript only, the Go half kept minting
unusable records, and both suites were green because each was internally
consistent. So both read the same cases from this one file.
The direction that matters is `refused`: a reader that ACCEPTS a policy the
other refuses is a sweep running on numbers nobody checked. No case relies on
either side being the more permissive one.
Every `toml` here is a WHOLE config — [roles.implement] included — because
that is what both readers are handed in practice.

cases.name: the design doc's own morning sweep
cases.why: UC7, written exactly as docs/design/cloud-factory.md writes it
cases.toml:
version = 2

[roles.implement]
kind = "claude"

[sweeps.morning-bugs]
cron = "0 4 * * 1-5"
filter = "type:bug priority<=2 unblocked"
max_ticks = 5
budget_usd = 10
tier = "economy"
gate_on_complete = "telegram"

cases.name: the optional keys are optional
cases.why: tier and gate_on_complete default; the four bounds do not
cases.toml:
version = 2

[roles.implement]
kind = "claude"

[sweeps.nightly]
cron = "30 2 * * *"
filter = "type:chore"
max_ticks = 1
budget_usd = 0.5

cases.name: two sweeps, reported in name order
cases.why: two policies due at the same minute must fire in the same order every time
cases.toml:

[roles.implement]
kind = "claude"

[sweeps.zebra]

filter = "type:bug"
max_ticks = 1
budget_usd = 1

[sweeps.alpha]

filter = "label:sweepable priority<3"
max_ticks = 2
budget_usd = 2

cases.name: no sweeps at all
cases.why: the common path; a repository declaring none is never swept

cases.why: a sweep runs with nobody watching, so it names what it may spend

cases.name: a missing max_ticks
cases.why: how many ticks a sweep selects is not a number anything downstream can invent
